name: Chicory
long_description:
A growing number of states require employers to provide: (1) Notice when automation is used to make decisions, (2) explanations of how automated decisions were made, and (3) options to opt out of or appeal automated decisions.

Chicory connects to applications where hiring, employment, and contracting decisions are made and takes care of notices, explanations, recourse, and risk assessments.
one_liner: The platform for automated hiring and workforce decisions.
